candidates.description: This vector represents the mental states, awareness, and psychological processes associated with consciousness and perception.
This vector represents internal emotional states, desires, and psychological experiences.
This vector represents medical treatments, clinical diagnoses, and patient care for various disorders.
This feature vector represents concepts related to the mind, mental health, and psychological or psychiatric studies.
This vector represents abstract concepts, methodologies, and theoretical frameworks used to explain phenomena.
This feature vector represents medical and clinical terminology, particularly relating to neurology, surgery, and healthcare facilities.
This feature represents the concept of examination, evaluation, and analytical study.
This vector represents cognitive states, mental processes, and internal attitudes related to thinking, believing, and perceiving.
This vector represents adverbs formed by adding suffixes like "-ly" to describe the manner, method, or domain of an action or state.
This vector represents verb suffixes and their morphological variants used to form actions, processes, or states.
